newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options volume in June up 50 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options volume in June up 50 pct yr/yr.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in June totaled 21,732,044 contracts, up 50 percent from 14,481,157 in June 1996, the Options Industry Council (OIC) said Monday.
The OIC said average daily volume in June was 1,034,859 contracts compared with 1,030,349 contracts in May.
Year-to-date volume through June totaled 125,464,913 contracts, a 25 percent increase over the 99,200,569 contracts traded in the first six months of 1996, the industry group said.
